sloka: यानि यान्यत्र योग्यानि श्वो भाविन्यभिषेचने ।तानि मे मङ्गLआन्यद्य वैदेह्याश्चैव कारय ॥२-४-३७॥
transliteration: yāni yānyatra yogyāni śvo bhāvinyabhiṣecane ।tāni me maṅgaLānyadya vaidehyāścaiva kāraya ॥2-4-37॥

translations.english: "Live long, dear child Rama. Your adversaries are destroyed. Endowed with royal fortune, gladden my kinsfolk and those of Sumitra."
